title: Unnamed settlement near Bouchiba, Algeria
description: Remains of an ancient settlement of Roman date, recorded by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas). The location should lie within 2 km of the BAtlas coordinates: a point to the east of Bouchiba, between it and the modern road connecting Golea and Tassamert el Foucani (Tassamert municipal territory, Bordj Bou Arreridj province, Algeria).

properties.description: Coordinates extracted using QGIS from a raster image of Barrington Atlas Map 31 that was georegistered to OpenStreetMap using prominent, stable landscape features. Dates after BAltDir.
properties.title: BAtlas Point Location
